svg.title: From merged pull requests to a release
svg.desc: The release bot keeps the pull request chore: release x.y.z for the pull requests merged into main. When the maintainer merges it, or by itself for dependency updates alone, a draft release with its tag is made. krankerl builds the package and check-package.sh checks it; it is signed with the app's certificate, checked again and gets a detached SHA-512 signature. The package, its signature, an SPDX SBOM and the signed build provenance make the published, immutable release, which goes to the Nextcloud App Store. The release verification checks it then and every week.
